title: The notice box
back: Issuing body → NOTICE → date → title → 50-word body → name, designation. All inside one box.

title: Five Ws of the body
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="What · When · Where · Who · Contact" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="20" y="70" width="50" height="40" rx="6" fill-opacity="0.2"/><text x="45" y="95" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">What</text><rect x="78" y="70" width="50" height="40" rx="6" fill-opacity="0.2"/><text x="103" y="95" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">When</text><rect x="136" y="70" width="50" height="40" rx="6" fill-opacity="0.2"/><text x="161" y="95" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Where</text><rect x="194" y="70" width="50" height="40" rx="6" fill-opacity="0.2"/><text x="219" y="95" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Who</text><rect x="252" y="70" width="50" height="40" stroke="#E0B400" rx="6" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.2"/><text x="277" y="95" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Contact</text><text x="160.0" y="50" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Tick all five before boxing the notice</text><text x="160.0" y="194" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">What · When · Where · Who · Contact</text></svg>
back: What is happening, when, where, for whom, and whom to contact (*the undersigned* + deadline). Missing one W costs a content mark.

title: Marks split 1 + 2 + 1
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Content is half the question" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="40" y="70" width="60.0" height="40" fill-opacity="0.2"/><text x="70.0" y="95" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Format 1</text><rect x="100.0" y="70" width="120.0" height="40" stroke="#E0B400" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.2"/><text x="160.0" y="95" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Content 2</text><rect x="220.0" y="70" width="60.0" height="40" fill-opacity="0.2"/><text x="250.0" y="95" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Expression 1</text><text x="160.0" y="50" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">4 marks</text><text x="160.0" y="194" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Content is half the question</text></svg>
back: Format 1 · Content 2 (five Ws) · Expression 1 (formal, third person, grammar).

title: Opening sentence
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="One sentence fixes audience, event, time, place" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="40" y="40" width="240" height="60" rx="8"/><path d="M56,100 l-6,10 l14,-10"/><text x="160.0" y="55" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">All students are hereby</text><text x="160.0" y="69" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">informed that … will be held</text><text x="160.0" y="83" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">on … at … in …</text><text x="160.0" y="194" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">One sentence fixes audience, event, time, place</text></svg>
back: Event: *All students are informed that…* · Lost/found: *A … was lost in … on …* · Meeting: *A meeting of … will be held on … to discuss …*

title: No I, no you
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="A notice speaks for the institution" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><text x="110" y="90" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">I</text><path d="M88,86 L132,86" stroke="#E0B400" stroke-width="2"/><text x="210" y="90" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">you</text><path d="M188,86 L232,86" stroke="#E0B400" stroke-width="2"/><text x="160" y="130" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Students are requested to…</text><text x="160.0" y="194" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">A notice speaks for the institution</text></svg>
back: Third person or passive only. *I request you all to come* loses the expression mark; *Students are requested to…* keeps it.

title: About 50 words
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="A 90-word notice reads as a paragraph" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="110" y="60" width="100" height="50" rx="6" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25"/><text x="160.0" y="92.0" text-anchor="middle" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">45–55</text><text x="160" y="140" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">body only; frame not counted</text><text x="160.0" y="194" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">A 90-word notice reads as a paragraph</text></svg>
back: Count the body only. Headings, date, title and signature are free. Over 70 words is the commonest reason a neat notice gets 3/4.

title: Match the role
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Designation must match the question exactly" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g><circle cx="80" cy="72.1" r="12.1" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><path d="M63.5,92.19999999999999 Q80,84.19999999999999 96.5,92.19999999999999 L93.86,123.80000000000001 L86.6,123.80000000000001 L87.92,170 H81.65 L80.66,126.0 H79.34 L78.35,170 H72.08 L73.4,123.80000000000001 L66.14,123.80000000000001 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/></g><text x="80" y="185" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Secretary, Eco Club</text><path d="M125,100 L185,100 M176.2,104.8 L185,100 L176.2,95.2" fill="none" stroke="#E0B400" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><rect x="190" y="70" width="110" height="60" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none" rx="6"/><text x="245" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none">ABC SCHOOL</text><text x="245" y="114" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none">issuing body</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Designation must match the question exactly</text></svg>
back: Club secretary → school is the issuing body; RWA secretary → society name. A mismatch is a format error spotted in one second.

title: Give it a short title
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="A title in capitals that names the event" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="28" y="40" width="264" height="90" rx="10" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.08" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="160" y="92" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">ANNUAL SPORTS DAY</text><text x="160" y="155" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">short, capitals, names the event</text></svg>
back: A title in capitals that names the event: 'ANNUAL SPORTS DAY'. It makes the notice easy to scan.
